south_cinema.finding: Regional theatre-minus-OTT genre preference scores; not viewing incidence. AP and Telangana combined.

ncaer.finding: State fiction-book preferences in Table 4.13; reading, not watching. Other NE states remain grouped.

barc.finding: State-market shares of national news impressions versus total-TV impressions; not viewer reach.

south_anime.finding: 310 purposively sampled anime respondents across five states; genre results pooled, collection year unreported.

intage.finding: Bengaluru anime-event lifestyle research; no state-by-genre viewing table.

jetro.finding: TV Asahi strategy interview; no measured state-genre percentages.

hakuhodo_global.finding: India-arm anime liking percentages; n=1000 potential anime users aged 16-39, fieldwork Aug-Sep 2025. No states.

genre_evolution.finding: Inspected indexed full text after PubMed access challenge. Underlying Zenodo data are top Bollywood grossers, not respondents or states.

southern_clusters.finding: 324 usable responses from five southern cities; published Likert comparisons by cluster and venue, not state cross-tabs.

ahmedabad.finding: Ahmedabad city n=100, Jan-Mar 2023; Table 3 has five-point film genre preference distributions.

raebareli.finding: 80 qualitative interviews in Raebareli and surroundings; action/thriller theme, no numerical genre prevalence.

kerala_venues.finding: 143 purposively sampled Kerala respondents; venue choice for mid-budget drama/comedy, not a genre popularity ranking.

representation.finding: Geographic and gender representation in film subtitles; no viewer state-genre survey.

delhi_ncr.finding: Original 220 responses inspected. City fields identify 162 Delhi, 45 Haryana, 12 UP and one Rajasthan respondent. Only Delhi meets n>=150.

chennai_anime.finding: Publisher PDF and Crossref DOI verified. Chennai city n=412, Oct 2025-Jan 2026, purposive/snowball sample. Four reported genre preferences.
